name.ja: Figure-riseBust ホシノ・フミナ エンディングVer.

description.ja: • 精巧なキャラクター胸像が手軽に手に入る組み立て式フィギュアシリーズ「Figure-rise Bust」に、ホシノ・フミナの第2弾が登場！
description.en: • The second installment of Fumina Hoshino is now available in the Assembly style figure series "Figure-rise Bust" where you can easily get elaborate character busts!

description.en: • The eyes are recreated using layered injection, and just by assembling, you can create a smile with captivating eyes!
